dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Thank you for choosing to stay with us. If you require any assistance, please let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: This inn was opened by my father, and I am the hostess.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: If you would like to stay here, please register your name, number of guests, reason for your stay, and number of days you'll be staying.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Oh, of course. If you don't want to leave your information, that's fine too. The registration is just for us to provide you with better service.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: By the way, you can use the elevator in front of the inn whether you're a guest or not, so you don't have to climb up the long incline.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: But if you're afraid of heights, there's nothing we can do...

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Oh yes, did you see a researcher with messy hair and dirty clothes on the way here?

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Hmm... Okay. He might have left Port Ormos.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: His name is Amandeep and he's a researcher who's lived here for a very long time. He makes a living by mentoring young researchers writing papers.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: A few days ago, I think it was the day the sea monsters were out and about, he went out and didn't come back. Without settling his bill with us.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: I'm not looking for him to settle his bill though. I'm just worried that he is in some sort of trouble because he just disappeared so suddenly.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: I've asked everyone in Port Ormos to help look for him but to no avail.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: ...When you encounter a stronger player, losing is a foregone conclusion.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Many of the guests who come here play Genius Invokation TCG, and of course I learned a lot from that.
